page: Amazon Web Services c8id.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor operating at 3.9 GHz. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, this x86_64 architecture server allocates dedicated CPU resources with 2.0 threads per core. The processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance features 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 22 Gbps. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8), alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. These hardware extensions accelerate vector calculations, matrix multiplication, and secure data processing directly on the CPU.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across multiple domains. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench image and text processing, and strong performance in software compilation, ray tracing, and Passmark database operations. Memory bandwidth tests show strong read-only performance for both small and large blocks, while write performance remains average. The system demonstrates strong capabilities in Redis SET operations, static web serving, and small-to-medium LLM inference prompt processing. Given the high-speed CPU, DDR5 memory, and local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is suited for compute-intensive workloads, database operations, software compilation, and localized machine learning inference.
